title: What the Meerkat calls out

is_this_you.pressure: When trouble shows, you name it out loud. Then you have the whole family in a ring before anyone panics.
is_this_you.love: You love by keeping watch and passing food. You talk the whole time, and you catch every word that comes back.
is_this_you.cost: You give a bark for every shadow on the sand, and some days the mob stops looking up.

opener.text: In 1999 Clutton-Brock and his colleagues gave the Kalahari's famous guards an unflattering title: “selfish sentinels” [m8]. A meerkat takes the lookout on a mound or branch only once it has eaten its fill [m2]. Britannica puts it plainly: sentinels are “not really the altruists they were once thought to be” [m2]. You were born a Gemini in a Rat year. You laughed at that, then went to check the horizon.

tabs.label: The lookout
tabs.intro: Air on top. Water below. A mound in the middle.

rows.text: Gemini is mutable Air, ruled by Mercury, curious and talkative [m11] [m12]. The Rat is yang Water, quick-witted and observant, with a nose for the next opening [m13] [m14]. You chatter and you watch at the same time. Most people manage one.
A sentinel on duty gives soft calls that tell the diggers below someone is on watch [m8]. You keep up the same running commentary. Your friends stop hearing it as noise and start hearing it as cover.

Meerkat alarm calls change with the predator and with how urgent it is [m1] [m3]. An aerial alarm sends the group into a crouch, and a ground alarm makes them scan and move [m1]. A separate call gathers everyone to face a snake [m1]. You have a word for every kind of trouble, and your people learn them all.
Old Rat lore says it lacks courage [m14]. The mob disagrees. When a snake comes close, meerkats often close in and mob it together [m3] [m1]. Alone you dive for a hole. With your people you advance.

tabs.label: Lessons
tabs.intro: Feed the young. Keep a cool tunnel ready.

rows.text: Every day at least one helper stays at the den with the pups and fasts while it guards them [m2]. Helpers feed pups for three to six months [m2]. You feed people who are not yours by blood, and you stopped keeping score long ago.

China Highlights lists broadcaster, writer and researcher among Rat careers [m14]. Add Mercury's speed and you fit teaching, dispatch and safety work. You earn most where an early warning is worth paying for.

tabs.label: Who has your back
tabs.intro: Three who take a shift on the mound. One who never lands.
tabs.love_lead: The Rat makes friends easily [m14]. Gemini bores easily [m12]. A shared burrow worth digging keeps your love busy enough to last. The old pairings name three who will take their turn on watch.

easy.why: The Kea (Gemini, Monkey year) shares your trine of Rat, Dragon and Monkey, and your sign as well [m15] [m11].
The Superb Lyrebird (Gemini, Dragon year) is trine kin and another Gemini, a mimic to answer every call you make [m15] [m11].
The Vulturine Guineafowl (Aquarius, Ox year) is your secret friend, since the Ox is the Rat's Six Harmonies partner, and Aquarius is Air like you [m15] [m11].

hard.why: The one who never lands is the Albatross (Sagittarius, Horse year): the Horse clashes with the Rat, and Sagittarius sits opposite Gemini [m15] [m11].

story.text: Kalahari helpers teach. For the youngest pups they kill or disable prey, pulling the sting from a scorpion before they hand it over [m5]. As the pups grow, the helpers bring live prey and nudge it back if a pup hesitates [m5]. Thornton and McAuliffe reported it in Science in 2006 as teaching in a wild mammal [m5].

closing: Eat your fill. Then climb the mound, and let the family dig in peace.
